T:P1.3.text: Distinctive Brands Inspired by the Human Spirit

T:P2.2.text: Deckers’ portfolio of brands combines style, comfort, and performance, each with its unique spirit. Whether navigating the rugged outdoors or strolling urban streets, our brands inspire individuals to embark on their unique journeys and express their true selves.

T:P2.3.text: by an Australian surfer on the coast of California, UGG® is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic Classic boot. First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors and then the world, UGG® designs and retails footwear, apparel, accessories and homewares with an uncompromising attitude toward quality and craftsmanship. UGG® partners with the best retailers globally and owns over 130 concept and outlet stores worldwide in key markets including New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Paris, London, Tokyo, Shanghai and ...

T:P2.4.text: HOKA produces premium performance footwear and apparel for athletes of all types. With a bold and unexpected approach, HOKA empowers a world of athletes to fly over the Earth.

T:P2.5.text: Pioneered Teva® stands for freedom in footwear. Teva believes that how you choose to live is the ultimate form of personal expression and our products are crafted to be accessible, versatile and a celebration of the independent spirit.

T:P3.2.text: Equally significant is our responsibility to employ socially conscious operations and sustainable business practices.

T:P3.3.text: As a global leader, Deckers is deeply committed to responsibility in everything we do.

T:P3.4.text: As a global leader in the footwear and apparel sector, our worldwide reach and impact are significant. Deckers is committed to delivering quality products while employing sustainable business practices.

T:P3.5.text: Deckers has established a robust Environmental and Social Governance (ESG) program. Through global community initiatives, mindful product creation, and our thoughtful supply chain efforts, sustainability is not just a goal, it’s what we do.

T:P3.6.text: Read our Creating Change report to learn more.

T:P3.7.text: VIEW REPORT Pathway to Creating Change

T:P3.8.text: As a leader in the footwear, apparel and accessories industry, our worldwide scope and impact is significant. Equally significant is our responsibility to employ socially conscious operations and sustainable business practices.

T:P3.9.text: We embrace each of our unique experiences, knowing that they help us foster connections, drive innovation and create a culture of belonging.

T:P3.10.text: The world has been very good to us. In turn, we want to be good to the world.

T:P3.11.text: At Deckers, we focus on positive change, innovate with purpose, and work to reduce our impact on the environment.

T:P3.12.text: Deckers operates in transparency of purpose and updates our policies regularly, in line with global standards and best practice.

T:P3.13.text: Adam Druckman, Event Manager, Deckers Brands

T:P3.14.text: “I feel blessed and grateful to be at Deckers. The business and life lessons gained from my years here are too many to count. I like to say that the future at Deckers is so bright we need to wear sunglasses… I truly envy the young folks that will be here to celebrate 100 years of Deckers. I wish I could produce that party…”
